concepts.summary: Run calls paired with a quick throw to a three receiver side. The inside receiver runs a bubble while the other two block the #1 defender and the most dangerous man, so the QB can pull the ball from the run and throw when the numbers favor it. Z Bolt is a one receiver version where the Z runs a quick bolt route off the Gain run.
concepts.qb: Read the count to the three man side before the snap. Run the play or throw the alert.
concepts.hb: Run the called play (Sponge, Sponge Exchange, Gain).

positions.Z: Block the #1 defender, or run the Bolt when tagged.

concepts.summary: Quick throws attached to runs when there are two receivers to a side. The options are a bubble from the inside man with the outside man blocking the most dangerous defender, a Stork by the X with the inside man blocking the man over him, a sight adjust hitch against a cat (press) corner, Nows by both outside receivers off Duo, an Insert Shield from a stack where the front man shields the defender, and an X Fade with the #2 running a Now.
concepts.qb: Check the count and the leverage on the two man side; throw the alert or hand the ball off.
concepts.hb: Run the called play (36 Sway, 15 Wanda, 16 Sift, 12 Duo).

positions.X: Stork, Fade, Now, or sight adjust hitch, by the call.
positions.Z: Block the man over, run the Now, or shield on the stack.

alerts: Sight adjust to a hitch against a cat corner on 16 Sift.
X Fade carries a #2 Now with it.

concepts.summary: Quick throws to a single receiver off a run. The X runs a Stork, a one step Now against a corner playing force or man on, or a Fade with a cutoff landmark. Off 17 Wash from bunch the single receiver sight adjusts to a hitch against a cat corner. The Y sifts and the rest of the picture runs the play.
concepts.qb: Look at the single receiver's corner before the snap. Throw the Now or Stork when the corner gives it, otherwise run the play.
concepts.hb: Run the called play (18 Zap, 17 Wash).

positions.X: Stork, Now (one step), Fade with a cutoff, or sight adjust hitch.

alerts: Now is a one step throw against force or man on.
Hitch sight adjust against a cat corner on 17 Wash.
